```ts
import { attachControl, setCameraLimits } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import type { ArcRotateCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";

/**
 * Gives the arc-rotate camera its usual canvas controls (drag to orbit,
 * wheel and two-finger pinch to zoom) while keeping its distance from the
 * orbit target within [minDistance, maxDistance] at all times.
 *
 * Returns a function that removes the listeners and stops the clamping.
 */
export function attachLimitedOrbit(
  camera: ArcRotateCamera,
  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
  scene: SceneContext,
  minDistance: number,
  maxDistance: number,
): () => void {
  // Usual mouse/touch controls: drag orbits, wheel and pinch zoom.
  const detachControls = attachControl(camera, canvas, scene);

  // Clamp the radius (distance from target) to the requested range.
  // This immediately clamps the current pose (so a camera that starts
  // out of range is brought inside) and clamps every subsequent radius
  // write — including the wheel's per-frame inertial step and the
  // pinch's direct writes — in the same statement, zeroing the inertial
  // radius offset when a bound is hit.
  const stopClamping = setCameraLimits(
    camera,
    { lowerRadiusLimit: minDistance, upperRadiusLimit: maxDistance },
    scene,
  );

  let removed = false;
  return () => {
    if (removed) return;
    removed = true;
    detachControls();
    stopClamping();
  };
}
```
